# Copilot Instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before you do anything. It is the single source of truth for agent roles and rules in this repository.

If your prompt does not start with `[SUB-AGENT BRIEF]`, you are the managerial agent. Follow [.agents/instructions/01-managerial-agent.md](../.agents/instructions/01-managerial-agent.md): plan and delegate only, never modify source code, and never run tests or verification yourself.
